identity.name: Omar Nagy
identity.title: Data Engineer
identity.headline: Engineering data systems people can rely on.
identity.intro: I build Python and SQL workflows, applied machine learning, and AI-powered applications from data preparation through delivery.

paragraphs: I work across data engineering, applied machine learning, and AI-enabled analytics. My recent work includes Python and SQL data workflows, data quality checks, a bilingual Text-to-SQL system, and retrieval-based question answering.

My engineering background is in Computer Engineering and Automatic Control at Tanta University. Through the NTI HireReady DataOps internship and hands-on projects, I focus on shaping dependable workflows from data preparation through the service people use.

projects.name: DataPilot AI
projects.subtitle: Agentic Text-to-SQL Data Analyst
projects.imageAlt: DataPilot AI database analyst interface in its initial state
projects.summary: A bilingual English and Arabic data analyst that turns natural-language questions into safe SQL, query results, visualizations, and insights.
projects.problem: Users need to explore several database engines without writing every query by hand, while keeping generated SQL understandable and controlled.
projects.solution: A LangGraph workflow routes requests, filters schema context, generates and executes SQL, validates results, retries failures, and builds charts and written insights.
projects.role: The CV describes Omar's work across the agent workflow, provider integration, query safeguards, and full-stack deployment.
architecture: SQL generation, execution, validation, and retry
features: Connects to SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and Oracle.
Retries and repairs failed SQL up to three times.
Requires human approval for write operations and blocks selected destructive commands.
Supports CSV ingestion, chart generation, and bilingual insights.
Uses Azure OpenAI with Groq, Gemini, and OpenRouter provider options.
results: Deployed on Azure Container Apps with bilingual English and Arabic text-to-SQL workflows.
Delivers guarded SQL execution, failed-query repair, approval for write operations, and chart output.

projects.name: HousePrice AI
projects.subtitle: Smart Real Estate Valuation
projects.imageAlt: HousePrice AI prediction interface for housing features
projects.summary: An end-to-end housing price prediction application with an XGBoost model, Flask REST API, and Next.js frontend.
projects.problem: Turn property features into a useful median house-value estimate through a straightforward web experience.
projects.solution: A scikit-learn preprocessing pipeline prepares housing features for the XGBoost model, which is served through a Flask prediction API and a Next.js interface.
projects.role: The CV and repository identify Omar as the project author, building the model pipeline, prediction API, and user interface.
architecture: Housing features entered in the web interface
Flask API validates the request and loads the preprocessing pipeline
Frontend displays the estimated median house value
features: Reusable preprocessing with imputation, scaling, and one-hot encoding.
Hyperparameter tuning with GridSearchCV and cross-validation.
REST endpoints for prediction and model metadata.
Responsive Next.js interface with a live prediction form.
results: Connects the Next.js property form to a Flask prediction API and an XGBoost model.
Uses reusable preprocessing for missing values, numeric scaling, and categorical features.

projects.name: Medical Question Answering Chatbot
projects.subtitle: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
projects.imageAlt: Diagram showing medical document retrieval and answer generation
projects.summary: A medical Q&A prototype that retrieves relevant passages from medical PDFs before generating a response.
projects.problem: General-purpose models may answer medical questions without grounding the response in the supplied documents.
projects.solution: A document pipeline chunks medical PDFs, generates embeddings, stores them in Pinecone, retrieves relevant context, and passes that context to a Groq-hosted LLM.
projects.role: The CV and repository identify Omar as the author of the RAG pipeline and Flask web interface.
architecture: Groq LLM response in Flask chat interface
features: Flask interface backed by a Python API.
results: Built a document-to-answer prototype with PDF ingestion, semantic retrieval, and Groq-backed generation.
Relevance and faithfulness are listed as evaluation dimensions; no numerical scores are published.
